stem: A worker corrects a wrong application date by replacing the old value in a shared log without preserving what changed or why. What is the main traceability problem?
choices: The edit destroys part of the audit trail and makes the sequence harder to reconstruct
The spreadsheet may have fewer rows
Only supervisors should be allowed to use dates
Application dates are optional once the crop is harvested
rationale: Silent replacement of prior values can destroy chronology and accountability. Corrections should preserve enough history to show what changed, why and by whom when the system supports it.
